kurz: Mascarpone is cream thickened in the heat with a little acid and then drained. It needs only two ingredients.
bild_im_kopf: Like whipped cream in slow motion: without a whisk, the cream thickens through warmth and acid alone.
dauer: 8–9 hours, of which 10 minutes of work
ergebnis: A thick, smooth cream, a little less than the amount of cream (as a guide).
material: ½ tsp citric acid dissolved in 4 tbsp water (or 2 tbsp lemon juice)
sieve lined with a fine cloth
verwendung: Tiramisu, cheesecake, risotto at the end instead of butter.
With sugar and vanilla as a filling.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Warm the cream slowly to about 82 °C
schluesselmomente.warum: The heat prepares the milk protein to react with the acid.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Stir in the acid and hold at this temperature for 2 minutes
schluesselmomente.warum: As with fresh cheese, the protein particles lose their charge. But because cream has so much fat, nothing flocculates: it just thickens creamily.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Take off the heat and rest for 30 minutes
schluesselmomente.warum: As it cools, the protein network between the fat droplets firms up.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Drain in the cloth in the fridge for 6–8 hours
schluesselmomente.warum: Only a little whey drips off. Cold makes the milk fat set, so it becomes spreadable.
